titre: Devoir de contrôle n°2 - Anglais (7ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
My name is Sarra and I want to tell you about my typical day. From Monday to Friday, I wake up at six thirty. First, I brush my teeth and get dressed. Then I have breakfast with my family: bread, cheese and a glass of milk. I go to school at seven forty-five. Our lessons start at eight o'clock. At noon, I have lunch at school with my friends. In the afternoon, I come back home at four o'clock. I do my homework, and in the evening I watch TV or read a book. I go to bed at nine o'clock.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What time does Sarra wake up on school days?   (2 marks)
2) What does she have for breakfast?   (2 marks)
3) Where does she have lunch?   (2 marks)
4) What does Sarra do in the evening?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with the present simple: Sarra (wake) ______ up at six thirty.   (1,5 marks)
2) Put in order the time words: (then / first / in the evening).   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "start" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Complete with a preposition (at / in / on): Lessons start ______ eight o'clock.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Write about your daily routine (about 6-8 lines). Say what you do in the morning, at noon and in the evening. Use the present simple and time words (first, then, after that…).
